cohort.source: multiresolution_experience_report_design prespecified Discovery stimulus-early/stimulus-late pair manifest

historical_K2_boundary.purpose_of_later_comparison: quantify how much inclusion of rating_early reorganized the earlier three-epoch family partition; never use the old labels to choose new K or centroids

multi_resolution_family_discovery.canonical_label_rule: lexicographic ordering of prespecified centroids in the fixed 14-cell signature coordinate order; never behavioral ordering
cross_resolution_outputs: ARI and NMI for every pair of eligible K resolutions
fine-to-coarse parent purity without assuming a tree
multi_resolution_family_discovery.no_eligible_K_rule: do not force discrete families; close the discrete experience-family branch and retain continuous reconfiguration signatures only

stability.comparison: adjusted Rand index versus the corresponding full Discovery K solution

next_after_discovery_stimulus_experience.if_at_least_one_K_eligible: validation_experience_transfer_design specifications Discovery templates/support thresholds and a one-shot Validation stimulus-only structural transfer before Validation signal values are opened
next_after_discovery_stimulus_experience.if_no_K_eligible: validation_experience_transfer_design records discrete-analysis conclusion and specifications a continuous experience/report dissociation route; no family taxonomy is invented

discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresol.primary_question: Does stimulus_early to stimulus_late EEG reconfiguration contain stable cross-person structure when rating_early and all human labels are excluded from discovery?

cross_person_standardization: within each participant, robust-center every transformed signature cell by the participant median
divide by participant IQR; use Discovery participant-balanced pooled IQR only when local IQR <= 1e-8
participant_stage_preprocessing: for each participant and each stimulus epoch separately, median-impute each of the 169 compact cells using that participant/stage only
divide by that participant/stage feature IQR
if stage IQR <= 1e-8, use participant-pooled early+late IQR for the same feature
if pooled IQR also <= 1e-8, use scale 1.0 and record the feature as locally constant
representation.participant_weight: each participant contributes total weight 1 regardless of trial count

global: RMS displacement across all 169 compact cells
cosine similarity across all 169 compact cells
per_block: RMS displacement between standardized stimulus_early and stimulus_late profiles
cosine similarity between standardized stimulus_early and stimulus_late profiles
trial_signature.reason: captures both magnitude and feature-profile reconfiguration while remaining outcome-free and excluding rating-stage activity

discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresol.scientific_role: Discovery-only outcome-free multi-resolution stimulus-experience reconfiguration discovery

opening_order: multiresolution_experience_report_design: metadata/hash/analysis specification only; no new EEG feature values and no labels
discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_fit: Discovery stimulus-only EEG feature values; no rating_early, behavior, category, context, stimulus identity, physiology, Validation, or Confirmation

validation_experience_transfer_design: specification templates/support thresholds and held-out structural transfer using only discovery_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_fit structural outputs; still no behavioral labels
validation_stimulus_experience_multiresolution_transfer: one-shot Validation stimulus-only structural transfer if authorized by validation_experience_transfer_design; no behavioral labels
later: specification and execute a separate Discovery report-transition structural branch without behavior
later: only after structural locks, specification exact tests of human-label mixing/fragmentation and report-transition association before opening behavioral values
Confirmation: remains closed for the new analysis until a pre-prespecified Validation structural gate explicitly authorizes it
physiology_boundary: raw event-aligned GSR/PPG remains outside the primary structural_replication program because <=1 s EEG-physiology synchronization was not recovered; physiology may only return under a separately prespecified feasible representation.
role: program-level analysis specification before any new signal-family inference

scientific_hypotheses.H_label_mismatch: human emotion labels may merge multiple reproducible neural regimes or may cut across the natural neural organization
scientific_hypotheses.H_report_transition: the neural transformation from stimulus processing into rating/report generation may be structurally distinct from the experience-period organization and may contribute to the weak EEG-to-report mapping

semantic_claim_boundary: No new family may be called joy, fear, anger, positive, negative, valence, liking, arousal, or another psychological construct from structural discovery alone.
High within-label neural heterogeneity alone does not prove that the human label is wrong; later held-out replication and explicit prespecified mapping tests are required.

An association between late-to-rating neural transformation and a report does not prove conscious distortion or dishonesty; the strongest allowed wording is report/evaluation-stage neural transformation unless stronger evidence is independently established.

separation_principle.forbidden: discovering a family from a representation that mixes experience and report transition and then treating it as a pure experience state
separation_principle.report_transition_branch: stimulus_late -> rating_early only, constructed later as a separate outcome-free branch
